@ the events of a producer at sample are summed by a receiver and read at sample: the sum up to the frame
@ a receiver read at sample / 2 sees at a tick the events of the frames before it: the event of the frame of the tick comes at the next tick
@ a producer at sample / 4 gives its event in its own stage, before the stage of sample / 2 and of sample of the same frame
@ before the first event the value is T.default() (0), and the first event of a delay with an init gives that init
@ one sample expression reads the last values of two calls with the events of their own
@ two producers written in order: the second reads a sum that has the event of the first of the same frame
@ events through three flows, in lets and nested, and through a flow whose output is the event of a call, are the same
@ a frame where the producer gives no event does not move the receiver
@ the state of an event is kept from one event to the next: a running maximum
@ a receiver written above a producer, read at a tick of sample / 4 of the same frame, has the events of the ticks before it
@ the same receiver written below the producer has the event of the frame of its tick
@ a receiver in the argument of the producer, fed by the producer through a delay, has the events of the frames before
@ a producer with an event input fed by its own output through a delay: its work of the frame comes before the event it gives ticks the input
@ delay~ of a value that is an event counts events, not frames
@ vdelay~ reads its length d as the last event, whose first value is 0 (saturated to 1)
@ what a delay stores reads the event value where it is written, in the argument or in a let of its own
@ what a delay stores reads a ^name at the end of the stage: the event of the frame itself
